_description: Priority to weight mapping for recommendation scoring. Weights are integers normalized internally. The defaults.priority level selects the initial weights from the priority_weights tiers.

_rationale.quality: Most users prioritize good model quality. Higher weights reflect this importance.
_rationale.cost: Cost is important but slightly less than quality. Reflects budget-conscious decision making.
_rationale.latency: Primarily handled by SLO targets. Acts as a tie-breaker in balanced scoring.
